entities.summary: Anton Johann Haus was an Austrian naval officer. Despite his German name, he was born to a Slovenian-speaking family in Tolmein. Haus was fleet commander of the Austro-Hungarian Navy in World War I and was the Navy's Grand Admiral from 1916 until his death.
